subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
course: Complex Textual Analysis, Synthesis & Research Reports
title: Grade 5 English Language Arts: Complex Textual Analysis, Synthesis & Research Reports
overview: Grade 5 English Language Arts immerses students in literary and informational texts, developing close reading comprehension, evidence-based writing, academic vocabulary, and collaborative discourse.
competencies: Read grade-level literary and informational texts with fluency, accuracy, and deep comprehension.
Cite specific textual evidence to substantiate answers, inferences, and central theme analyses.
Write clear, organized opinion, informative, and narrative compositions using standard grammar conventions.
Participate actively in collaborative discussions, expressing ideas clearly and building upon others' contributions.

modules.title: Quoting Textual Evidence & Comparative Theme Analysis
modules.description: Quoting accurately from literary texts, comparing stories in the same genre, and analyzing structural choices across poetry, prose, and drama.

topics.title: Quoting Text Directly to Defend Inferences
topics.description: Integrating direct quotations to substantiate explicit details and subtle inferences.

topics.title: Comparing and Contrasting Literary Themes
topics.description: Analyzing how different authors approach similar themes and worldviews.

modules.title: Critical Informational Reading & Evaluating Author Arguments
modules.description: Explaining relationships between individuals, scientific concepts, and historic events, and evaluating logical reasoning in arguments.

topics.title: Complex Interactions in Informational Texts
topics.description: Analyzing multi-step scientific procedures, historical causes, and technical explanations.

topics.title: Evaluating Author Claims and Evidence
topics.description: Differentiating between well-substantiated facts and subjective assertions in opinion articles.

modules.title: Rigorous Research Reports & Persuasive Argument Essays
modules.description: Writing extensive research papers using multiple credible print and digital resources, organizing arguments, and citing bibliography entries.

topics.title: Argumentative Persuasive Essays
topics.description: Crafting logically organized claims, defending them with verified evidence, and using formal tone.

topics.title: Multi-Source Synthesis Research Reports
topics.description: Paraphrasing and quoting information from digital sources without plagiarizing, providing bibliographies.
